scenes.caption: A seedling.
scenes.say: Faiza has a ber sapling to plant in Islamabad.

scenes.caption: A native tree.
scenes.say: The ber is a native tree. It suits the local climate.

scenes.caption: Planting.
scenes.say: She digs a hole, plants the sapling and waters it.

scenes.caption: Shade.
scenes.say: Years later, the tree gives cool shade.

scenes.caption: Homes.
scenes.say: Birds and insects make their homes in its branches.

scenes.caption: Clean air.
scenes.say: The tree takes in carbon and gives out oxygen.

scenes.caption: Fruit.
scenes.say: Neighbours enjoy the fruit. It is a lasting kindness.

scenes.caption: Many trees.
scenes.say: One tree helps. Many trees together help the whole planet.
